title: Dataset: EEG-Controlled Exoskeleton for Walking and Standing - A Longitudinal Study of Healthy Individuals
description: A longitudinal brain-machine interface dataset from seven healthy adults who controlled a Rex Bionics lower-limb exoskeleton through motor imagery (walk/stop). Each participant completed nine sessions, each with an open-loop calibration training phase followed by twelve closed-loop control trials and extended 6-minute walk and stop imagery tasks. The dataset includes 60-channel EEG, EOG, IMU motion data from the head and exoskeleton, and exoskeleton control and feedback signals.
methods_description: Sixty-channel scalp EEG and 4-channel EOG were recorded alongside two IMUs (forehead and exoskeleton back brace) and logged exoskeleton control signals and BMI decoder predictions. Each of nine sessions per participant had a motor imagery calibration phase without feedback, then 12 closed-loop trials in three blocks, followed by 6-minute walk and stop imagery tasks. Raw data are provided without filtering or artifact removal.
